column1: # Chrome, through `just conformance`. A shrink-to-fit block around an image sized in percent.
# Measured on Chrome Headless Shell 159.0.8154.6, the chromium Playwright pins here.
# The art is 80x40, a `display: block` image with the sizing named. Its block is
# shrink-to-fit: `absolute` with `width: auto` in a positioned root, a `flex-item`,
# or the item in a `grid-auto` column, at the start on both axes. The root is `room`
# wide and 100 tall at the origin. Both rectangles are border boxes from `getBoundingClientRect`.
